title: Norwegian Veal Korma Casserole
description: A unique fusion of Indian and Norwegian flavors, this casserole combines tender veal with charred spices and a hint of kissed sweetness.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the veal and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion and ginger and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the kissed cinnamon, charred paprika, and garam masala.
Add the casserole and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the veal is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
